excerpts.content:
The lodestar decoupled blobs branch (https://github.com/ChainSafe/lodestar/pull/5181) is now functional (still on the indepedent blob/block production/publishing + some cleanup and  blob gossip validations still wip) 🥳 

Have been able to set a local devnet (with a corresponding ethereumjs  branch:https://github.com/ethereumjs/ethereumjs-monorepo/pull/2567) where 
a) peer1 is producing blobs
b) And peer2 syncs block and blobs

1. Initially via req/resp to get Synced
2. Then via gossip to stay Synced

Onto now plugging missing parts
